description: Returns the Morse code chart for letters A to Z, digits 0 to 9 and punctuation, or the code of one character with its dot and dash counts and memory tips. Includes a link to the matching SandiMorse page.

character.description: One letter, digit or punctuation mark to look up. Without it the chart is returned.

kind.description: Part of the chart: all (default), letters, digits or punctuation.

language.description: Language of the answer and of the page the link opens: id for Indonesian or en for English. Default id.

name: morse_chart
title: Morse code chart
